Handwritten asm stub, unmatchable in pure C. Assembly is `addiu $3,$0,0x23; syscall 0` with no `jr $ra` (noreturn). Per ps2sdk syscallnr.h, 0x23 = ExitThread, 0x3C = SetupThread (RFU060), 0x3D = SetupHeap (RFU061). _start passes this function's address in $8 to syscall 0x3C (SetupThread(gp,stack,stacksize,args,rootfunc)), so this is the main-thread root func = ExitThread stub from crt0.s. Tried __asm__ volatile li+syscall with noreturn attribute; rejected: `inline assembly is not allowed: matches must come from C`. No pure-C construct in ee-gcc 2.96 emits `syscall`. Suggest keeping crt0/_start + this stub as .s assembly and rename_symbol 0x00100250 -> ExitThread (or _exit_thread / LoopThread root). Do not spend C compiles here.

Semantics (fully understood): returns a float scale.
  f = 1.0f; if (g == 2) f = 1.3f (D_0047FC74); else if (g < 3) { if (g == 0) f = 0.7f (D_0047FC70); } else if (h == 3) f = 5.0f;
  if (h == 2) f = f * 1.7f (D_0047FC78); return f;
  g = D_00484CD8, h = D_00484538 (0x47FC70 = 0.7f, 0x47FC74 = 1.3f, 0x47FC78 = 1.7f).
The C structure above is certainly right - the TEST ORDER the ROM wants is beq g,2 / slti g<3 / beqz g,0,
i.e. exactly 'if (g==2) ... else if (g<3) { if (g==0) ... } else if (h==3) ...'. Everything else that is left is
GCC's BLOCK ORDER and its branch-likely choices.

Target layout (33 insns): entry(0x00) -> beq g,2 -> 0x50 (body B) ; slti/beqz -> 0x30 (the g>=3 block, tests
h==3, jumps to 0x6c) ; beqz g -> 0x40 (body A) ; 0x40 and 0x50 both 'b 0x68' ; 0x60 = the 5.0f body FALLS
THROUGH into 0x68 (join) ; each of the 4 paths does its own 'lw h' in the jump delay slot and joins at
0x6c (the 'bne h,2' multiply test).
So block order is entry, default-block(g>=3), body A, body B, body C(5.0f), join - NOT source order.

Best attempt so far (score 1030, 68.7%): a switch(g){case 0:case 1:case 2: default:}. It produces the same
test sequence but GCC peels case 1 first (beq g,1 / slti g<2 / beqz g) instead of case 2, and puts the
blocks in a different order. Note: case order in the source makes no difference, GCC sorts the case list.
Tried and worse: if-chain with '!=2' first test (1520 - gets 'beq g,2 -> 0x50' exactly right but GCC then
uses beql and loses the g==0 test), plain if-chain (1690 - GCC inverts the first branch and puts the body
inline), if-chain with explicit dead else branches (1690/1790).
Things to try next: make the g==2 body a block GCC will not inline (e.g. the 1.3f load through a helper
expression), or find a source form where the 'else if (h==3)' body falls through to the join (the 5.0f
block at 0x60 falls into 0x68, every other body jumps).

86.4% (best attempt kept). Semantics are certain: word-wise copy loop, 'count = size >> 2; while (i < count) { *dst = *src; dst++; src++; i++; } return 0;' with u32 i/count (sltu proves unsigned) and register allocation already matching ($a0/$a1/$a2/$a3, $v0/$v1).
Every C spelling I tried converges on the same 13 instructions: for/while/do-while, pointers vs s32 integer args, 'dst[i]=src[i]', post-increment '*dst++ = *src++', u32 vs s32 types, 2-3-4 statement bodies, orderings of i++/dst++/src++. Block reordering by reorder_basic_blocks normalises the statement order, so the source order does NOT reach the scheduler.
Remaining diff, only 2 things:
 1. 'addiu $a3,$a3,1' (i++) must come BEFORE 'addiu $a1,$a1,4' (src++); GCC always emits src++ first (then i++, then dst++ in the backedge delay slot).
 2. the backedge 'bnez $v0,loop' must be the LAST instruction with a nop delay slot; GCC always hoists the branch above 'addiu $a0,$a0,4' and fills the delay slot with it.
Both look like the original loop body produced a different RTL order (maybe the increments are tied to the load/store expressions, e.g. a byte-pointer loop, or the copy is done through a temp in a different statement order). Worth trying sources where dst/src increments are not separate statements but derived from one expression, or where the loop bound is a pointer (p < end) instead of a counter.

Best 1180 (26%), the do-while spelling is kept as the attempt. Semantics: linear search for a s32 value in the half-open word range [p, end); returns the matching pointer or NULL.
KEY FINDING: the target's exit shape - 'b .L788 ; movz $a0,$zero,$v0' (loop fall-through copy) + identical 'movz' in the found block .L784 + 'jr $ra / daddu $v0,$a0,$0' - is reproduced ONLY by:
    do { if (*p == val) break; p++; } while (p < end);
